text_block_list.text:
For Seiun Sky,
her second summer training camp had begun.

Since I had gotten off early to help out with academy duties,
I went to go meet her at the bus, when—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
King~.
Give me a piggyback back to the training camp~.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I won't!!
Good grief, pull yourself together a little!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...It was on the way, that's all.
More importantly, are you alright?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Sky-san's been like this the whole time on the bus.
She doesn't look motivated at all.

True, she's lounging around, but...
Seiun Sky always gives it her all
while pretending to have no motivation.
choice_data_list: I get serious when I'm training!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Well, if that's the case, sure, but...

With an lingering sense of unease hanging over us,
the summer training camp began...
